# Catalog

A data domain: a catalog with its storage location, an owner group and grants.

## Spec

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description | Constraints |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `spec.description` | string (nullable) | No |  |  | max 500 |
| `spec.displayName` | string (nullable) | No |  |  | max 100 |
| `spec.grants` | array of object | No | `[]` |  | max 50 |
| `spec.grants[].group` | string | Yes |  |  | min 1, max 64; pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$` |
| `spec.grants[].verb` | string | Yes |  | What a grant lets a group do with a catalog. Six verbs exist; `use` belongs to compute (`SqlWarehouse`) and is not a data verb. There is no deny, no `ALL PRIVILEGES` and no per-column verb. | `browse`, `select`, `write`, `create`, `manage` |
| `spec.lakehouseRef` | object | Yes |  | The `Lakehouse` that hosts a catalog or a warehouse. |  |
| `spec.lakehouseRef.name` | string | Yes |  |  | min 1, max 63; pattern `^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?$` |
| `spec.managedAccess` | boolean | No | `false` | True: the owner cannot grant on this catalog; only platform administrators can. |  |
| `spec.owner` | string | Yes |  | Exactly one group. Ownership means `manage` and does not mean `select`. | min 1, max 64; pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$` |
| `spec.storage` | object (nullable) | No |  | Where a catalog's data files live. Omitted: the `Lakehouse`'s storage defaults. |  |
| `spec.storage.bucket` | string (nullable) | No |  | An isolated bucket per catalog. | min 3, max 63; pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*[a-z0-9]$` |
| `spec.storage.credentialSecretRef` | object (nullable) | No |  | The per-catalog storage identity. A reference only: the Secret is never part of this resource. |  |
| `spec.storage.credentialSecretRef.key` | string | Yes |  |  | min 1, max 253; pattern `^[-._a-zA-Z0-9]+$` |
| `spec.storage.credentialSecretRef.name` | string | Yes |  |  | min 1, max 253; pattern `^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9.]*[a-z0-9])?$` |
| `spec.storage.keyPrefix` | string (nullable) | No |  | Required where all catalogs share one bucket (the demo profile); no leading slash, no `..`. | max 512; pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_./-]*$` |

## Validation rules

- each group may hold each verb once
- storage.keyPrefix must not contain .. or //
